description: Holds up to 32 parameters of other modules at fixed values, so they cannot be changed by mouse or by the Randomize menu item.

params.text: Starts binding: press it, then click a knob, fader, switch or button to lock it at its current value.

notes: locked parameters survive a STRIP file as long as this module is part of the strip.
nothing is locked until the button is pressed and a knob, fader, switch or button on another module is clicked; a red square marks each locked parameter.
menu: Locked parameters — lists each locked parameter by its module and its name, and clicking one releases it.
Audio rate processing — holds the locked parameters every sample rather than every 64th sample.
